title: The First Quarter
description: Elara Vostane has the quarterly numbers. GDP contracted. Unemployment rising in Kravenstal. Inflation accelerating. The IMA job cuts begin next quarter. Two hundred thousand people will feel this government in their household budgets.

title: Budget Allocation — Mid-Quarter Adjustment
description: The quarterly numbers demand a fiscal response. Adjust allocations before the IMF conditions lock in the current framework.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora's deadline is week 10. She has been waiting since week 3. Your daughter is patient. Patience is not the same thing as forgiveness.

title: The Archbishop's Response
description: Renek sent a personal letter. Handwritten. He doesn't do that for everyone. Your response — or silence — will communicate more than any policy statement.

title: Opposition Floor Count
description: Vyktor reports that Kolvar has been counting votes. Quietly. The Halvekist bloc is unified. The question is whether the independents are wavering.

title: The Aldenmoor Estate
description: An invitation arrived on paper thicker than most men's salaries. Stefan Morvec requests the pleasure of your company at dinner. Aldenmoor Province. Saturday. No agenda mentioned.
